about_the_game:
The DLC 1 & 2 Set includes the following content:
- DLC 1
5 playable units
16 Area Missions
2 Assist Crew members
- DLC 2
5 playable units
16 Area Missions
1 Assist Crew member
- DLC 1 & 2 Set Bonus
2 Area Missions that reward Xelguard, Tyranado, and Tyranado Rex
1 bonus mission
- 2-day Early Access for DLC 1-2

*Individual DLCs can be purchased as standalone products. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Content will be available by August 2026.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains language not appropriate for all ages, revealing outfits, animated violence, mild alcohol references, and mild suggestive themes.
